test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Instead of taking the time to do the job properly, they decided to __cut corners__ and save time by using cheap materials.

options.text: physically cut a corner off of something
take a shortcut for easy way out in order to save efforts

solution: The correct answer is: "cut corners" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"cut corners"** refers to doing something in the easiest, quickest, or cheapest way. (कोने काटना या शॉर्टकट लेना) • **Example: **To meet the deadline, they decided to cut corners on the project, which affected the quality of the work. • **"Take a shortcut for an easy way out in order to save efforts" **aligns with the meaning of "cut corners" as it involves finding a quicker or simpler way to do something, often at the expense of quality or completeness. (आसान रास्ता चुनना ताकि प्रयास कम किया जा सके) • **Example: **Instead of conducting thorough research, the student decided to cut corners and copied most of the information from a single source. • Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate option to substitute **"cut corners"** in the given sentence is **"take a shortcut for easy way out in order to save efforts".** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Avoid someone or something intentionally** (जानबूझकर किसी या किसी चीज़ से बचना): Choosing not to engage with or confront something or someone. • **Physically cut a corner off of something** (किसी चीज का कोना शारीरिक रूप से काटना): Literally removing a part or edge of something, making it less than whole. • **Break a promise or commitment** (वादा या प्रतिबद्धता तोड़ना): Failing to fulfill an agreement or promise made to someone. 46:Tcc1, The correct answer is: Option (1) i.e. "**Folktale"**.
